impl.summary: FLUX 3 Image Klein now runs on both engines. Open engine: oss-flux3-klein does text to image (up to 4K) and edits with up to 10 references on two new core-node ComfyUI graphs; oss-flux3-klein-base runs Klein Base with LoRAs. All three graphs are validated on the CPU ComfyUI. Options → Prompt helper (BFL's upsampler) is on by default; when it is off, or a layout is attached, the provider takes it out. Cloud engine: flux-3-klein runs fal's text-to-image and edit routes, and a run with LoRAs goes to their /lora twins. flux-3-klein-base runs Klein Base's LoRA routes. A layout goes to fal's bounding_boxes with prompt expansion off. Soul ID gains a FLUX 3 Klein family, trained on fal's Klein Base trainer or on AI-Toolkit's flux3 model. Licences are recorded as information and stay switched on. Nothing became a default.
built: Research: scripts/fetch-hosted-schemas.py --new10 read fal's six Klein endpoints into docs/research/new-models-10.json endpointRecords (all active) and the two Klein Base trainers into fuobe-originals-recipes-5.json trainers[]. Re-checked at the source on 2026-11-01: per-image prices $0.008 at 768² / $0.009 at 1K / $0.011 at 1.5K / $0.014 at 2K / $0.036 at 4K (fal calls them 'planned'); /lora $0.012/MP; Klein Base /lora $0.035/MP; trainer $0.0043 a step with at least 100 billed; loras ≤3 of {path, scale 0-4}; image_size 256-4096; num_images 1-4; bounding_boxes take {box {x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max} as fractions, label, description}, at most 32. HF revisions 337337621b85 and feef60b0 confirmed. The licence was read from the card.

Cloud catalog (scripts/gen-cloud-models.py → cloud-models.generated.ts): model flux-3-klein. Its t2i and edit routes have loraEndpoint set to the /lora twins. tier_size reads 1K/1.5K/2K/4K from the price line, so image_size is the aspect ratio on the tier's square (FieldMap.size.bases). Pricing is per image byResolution, plus Pricing.withLorasPerMegapixel 0.012 for LoRA runs. Model flux-3-klein-base has LoRA routes only at $0.035/MP. FieldMap.boundingBoxes comes from the research keyFields.

Layout: flux3Caption and flux3Boxes in src/lib/layout-prompt.ts share compileFlux3's rows. On fal, planLayout sends the boxes in bounding_boxes and the caption naming <obj_N> as the prompt. On the GPU the compileFlux3 table is the prompt. fal's limits (32 boxes, 500 characters a box) are checked before a run.
ComfyUI graphs, hand-built from Comfy-Org's image_flux3_klein_* templates using core nodes only:
flux3-klein-edit: ten LoadImage nodes feed ReferenceMultiLatent and the helper's BatchImagesNode; 16 steps, euler; the result takes reference 1's shape.
flux3-klein-base-t2i-lora: 50 steps, CFG 3.5; LoRAs are injected after the loader.
All three run TextGenerate on BFL's w4a8 upsampler with the pup repo's t2i/i2i system prompts (Apache-2.0) and the card's greedy decoding.

Build, validation and the requirements index: build and validate-workflows passed 3/3 on the live CPU ComfyUI. Binding keys image5..image10 added. Files are pinned in model-pins.json (revision feef60b0, exact sizes) and marked gated. A gated optional file is now marked gated too. requirements.json is rebuilt. No new pack.

Provider (src/server/providers/comfyui.ts): binds up to 10 reference slots. ReferenceMultiLatent and BatchImagesNode are optional-reference encoders, so unused references drop from the last. skipPromptHelper (src/lib/comfy.ts) runs for PROMPT_HELPER_GRAPHS when promptHelper is 'off' or a layout is attached. An 11th image is refused by the plan (route maxImages 10), not dropped.

Open ModelDefs: oss-flux3-klein (t2i + edit, maxImages 10, layout flux3, Prompt helper control) and oss-flux3-klein-base. Placed after Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo with the top badge, so the Image studio's Best list on your GPU is Ideogram 4, Qwen-Image 2.1, FLUX 3 Klein, Krea 2 Realism, and the Edit studio's includes Klein. The Image studio takes 10 references and the Edit studio 1 image + 9 references, each capped by the model.

Training: TrainingFamily flux3-klein (lead oss-flux3-klein-base / flux-3-klein-base; also runs on the distilled models). Target fal-flux3-klein: 1,000 steps for $4.30, resolution 1024, trigger_phrase. Target aitk-flux3-klein: AI-Toolkit's flux3 arch on black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-base with convrot8 and shift timesteps. Both say the licence is not blanket permission for commercial fine-tuning. gen-trainers reads 'per training step' and 'minimum N steps', and leaves the edit trainer's per-reference price unpriced rather than guess it.

Licences (information only): KLEIN_LICENSE on the graphs; the FLUX Kommunity License reads as class 'conditions'; the cloud models carry ModelLicence. Settings → LoRAs names the 'FLUX 3 Klein' base. Assist's model summary now includes readsLayoutBoxes, the weights' licence and the per-megapixel LoRA price.
Canvas image node: lists all four Klein models (catalog-driven, with a test). The GPU pre-flight picks up the models as tools automatically; no new studio row was needed.
Research corrections are recorded in docs/research/new-models-10.md §7.

Existing tests updated: open-sota-studios (Best lists), licences, gpu-readiness, gpu-requirements (size budget, merged with main's raised 216 KB/27 KB, plus Klein's gated repo), training, open-engine, cloud-catalog. Browser: tests/e2e/flux3-klein.mjs, 123 checks, all passed at 1440 and 390 px in light and dark, in demo mode and again with FAL_KEY=anything. It covers the Image studio picker on both engines, the Best list, the price before the run, the Prompt helper with its text not cut off, the Edit studio with an image and 9 references, the Train dialog's FLUX 3 Klein section ($4.30 / Free / licence) and both Settings rows switched on, with no sideways scroll. Full Vitest suite with --maxWorkers=2 after merging the latest claude/fuobe-parity-4: 4585 passed, 1 failed, 3 skipped. The one failure, tests/gpu-api.test.ts 'stops a run whose model is missing…', got 503 'The studio is short of space' because this machine has 18 GB free, below the account disk floor. It passes with FUOBE_ACCOUNT_DISK_FREE_GB=1, so it comes from the environment, not this package. tsc is clean.

Not done: an open-engine trainer for edit LoRAs (fal's /base/trainer/edit is recorded but unused); the cloud's plain /base/text-to-image and /base/edit-image endpoints (not in fal's catalog listing); the upsampler's *_bbox system prompts for layouts (a layout skips the helper on both engines instead).

The model files' SHA-256 can't be read without an HF token (the gated tree hides them), so model-pins has revision and size only. Pin them with `node scripts/comfy/build-requirements.mjs --refresh-pins` and HF_TOKEN.

Brief deviations: (1) no separate oss-flux3-klein-edit. oss-flux3-klein carries both t2i and edit, as the cloud flux-3-klein does, and a separate edit model would have appeared twice in the Edit picker. oss-flux3-klein-base and flux-3-klein-base were added for the Base LoRA graph and fal's Base LoRA routes. (2) Out-of-date details in the brief: the repack is black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy, not Comfy-Org; Fuobe's install pin is fc04da91 (v0.41.0-7) and already has every class, so no pin bump; compileFlux3 is no longer at L511.

findings.title: Cloud FLUX 3 Klein edits always come out at the chosen aspect ratio (1:1 by default), not the photo's shape, while the GPU edit keeps reference 1's shape
findings.where: scripts/gen-cloud-models.py tier_size branch (build_route) -> FieldMap.size on both edit routes of flux-3-klein and flux-3-klein-base in src/lib/catalog/cloud-models.generated.ts; src/lib/catalog/payload.ts L459-464 (always writes image_size); src/server/generations.ts sizedMixedFrame/SIZED_EDITS (the existing precedent, not applied here)
findings.detail: planGeneration merges model.defaults {aspectRatio: '1:1', resolution: '1K'}, and buildPayload always writes image_size from it. A probe plan of an Edit studio run (feature edit, one image, no params) on flux-3-klein sends image_size {width:1024,height:1024}, so a 16:9 photo comes back as a 1024x1024 square. fal's schema makes image_size nullable: 'If not set, a single reference image's own size (scaled to at most 4 megapixels) is used, or the first reference image's size (at most 1 megapixel) when several are given'. The GPU route for the same model is `unsized` and follows reference 1. Klein's two edit routes are the only cloud edit routes in the catalog that always send a size object (probe over MODELS). The two engines behave differently and the UI does not say so. No test covers a default-sized cloud edit.
findings.fix: Size the cloud edit from reference 1's shape at the chosen tier, as sizedMixedFrame does for MIXED_ORIGINAL/ANGLES_ORIGINAL (localHead -> imageSize -> fit on the tier's square). This keeps the price predictable. Or offer an 'auto' (keep shape) aspect that leaves image_size out. Add a payload test for the default edit.

findings.title: The cloud engine has no Prompt helper switch, although fal's endpoints accept enable_prompt_expansion
findings.where: src/lib/catalog/models.ts KLEIN_PROMPT_HELPER (open models only); payload.ts L529 (promptExpansion is only ever set to false for a layout)
findings.detail: On the GPU, Options -> Prompt helper on/off chooses between BFL's upsampler and the words as typed. On the cloud, flux-3-klein and flux-3-klein-base always run fal's expansion (default true) unless a layout is attached. All six fal routes take a boolean enable_prompt_expansion (re-read from fal's OpenAPI on 2026-11-01). Under the owner's rule (each engine does all the hosted endpoint supports, and says so), the cloud user should be able to send a full caption as typed. The UI currently shows the control only on one engine and gives no reason.
findings.fix: Give the cloud models the same 'Prompt helper' control, mapped to enable_prompt_expansion (on = API default, off = false), and keep it false whenever a layout is attached.

findings.title: Layout mode switches off BFL's prompt helper on both engines, even with zero boxes, and the UI never says so
findings.where: src/server/providers/comfyui.ts (carriesLayout -> skipPromptHelper); payload.ts L529; composer enterLayout/layoutRequest attach an empty draft
findings.detail: carriesLayout() is true for an empty draft. A probe of a cloud layout with no items sends enable_prompt_expansion:false, and on the GPU the helper branch is removed. BFL's -comfy card says its workflows run the upsampler 'including with reference images and bounding boxes', and the pup repo ships t2i_bbox/i2i_bbox system prompts for that case. The implementer recorded this choice under 'left'. Still, a user who sets Prompt helper to On has it silently overridden in Layout mode, and the label ('On · writes a full caption') does not mention it. On fal, turning expansion off with boxes is what the brief asked for.
findings.fix: At least name the override in the control's label or in the Layout mode hint. Later, run the helper with the *_bbox system prompts on the GPU, and skip the override when the draft has no boxes.

findings.title: fal does host plain Klein Base text-to-image and edit, so a Base run without LoRAs is priced on the /lora route
findings.where: flux-3-klein-base in scripts/gen-cloud-models.py; implementer's 'left' note ('not in fal's catalog listing')
findings.detail: fal.ai/models/blackforestlabs/flux-3/klein/base/text-to-image exists ('FLUX.3 Klein Base (Text to Image) API on fal', planned per-image pricing 768: $0.024, 1K: $0.027, 1.5K: $0.033, 2K: $0.042, 4K: $0.108), and its OpenAPI schema and base/edit-image's both resolve. flux-3-klein-base runs everything on /base/*/lora at $0.035/MP, LoRAs or not. A Base run without LoRAs costs $0.56 at 4K on the /lora route against the planned $0.108. The model's name ('with LoRAs') makes it an edge case, but the research note's statement is wrong.
findings.fix: Record base/text-to-image and base/edit-image in new-models-10.json. Either add them as flux-3-klein-base's plain routes, with the /lora twins as loraEndpoint (the same pattern as flux-3-klein), or correct the note.

findings.where: src/lib/catalog/models.ts (oss-flux3-klein with the 'top' badge, placed after Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo); tests/open-sota-studios.test.ts
findings.detail: Measured with studioBest on base vs branch. Image (open): [Ideogram 4, Qwen-Image 2.1, Krea 2 Realism, MOSS-Image] -> [Ideogram 4, Qwen-Image 2.1, FLUX 3 Klein, Krea 2 Realism]. The brief asks only for multi-reference in the Edit studio, not a Best-list place. Klein lands there because the 'top' badge applies to every operation, which pushes out the only light, fast FIBO edit. It is defensible (10 references, top arena model), but it is the owner's call, and the implementer flagged it as one. No owner decision in owner-decisions.json covers Best-list ranking.

review.verdict: Approve with fixes. The package is correct and well verified at the source: schemas, prices, HF revisions, sizes, licence, system prompts, node classes and AI-Toolkit support all check out. Tests and types are green, and there are no sign-up, security or licence-as-gate problems. Before merge, fix finding 1: cloud Klein edits come out square by default, while the GPU keeps the photo's shape. Finding 2, a cloud Prompt helper on enable_prompt_expansion, is a small parity gap worth closing in the same pass. Findings 3 and 4 are notes. Finding 5, the MOSS-Image and FIBO 2 Edit Turbo drops, is an owner call: the Image Best list follows the brief, and the Edit Best list goes beyond it, which the PR should flag.

applied: Finding 1 (medium, confirmed: a default cloud edit plan sent image_size 1024x1024): cloud Klein edits (flux-3-klein, flux-3-klein-base) are now sized from reference 1's shape at the chosen tier. ModelRoute.followsImage is a new route flag that gen-cloud-models.py emits on both edit routes. sizedEdit in src/server/generations.ts runs beside sizedMixedFrame: it reads image 1's header (localHead -> imageSize) and puts the shape on the tier's square with sizeValue (16 px grid, 256-4096), so a 4000x2250 photo at 1K goes as 1360x768. A size the request gives itself wins, and a picture that isn't a file in Fuobe keeps the aspect ratio's size. The per-image tier price is unchanged, and the LoRA per-megapixel price reads the size sent. The composer (settingsShape) shows Resolution but no Aspect ratio for these edits, so the UI says what happens. Payload and run tests (createGenerations through the demo provider), plus a browser check.

Finding 2 (low-medium, confirmed: all six fal routes take enable_prompt_expansion): the cloud Klein models get the same Options -> Prompt helper control (param promptHelper). 'off' sends enable_prompt_expansion false; 'on' leaves fal's default. promptHelper is never sent to fal: it is in each route's map.ignore and in payload.ts's ignore set. A layout with boxes still forces expansion off. Covered by payload tests for all four routes and a browser check on the cloud.

Finding 3 (low, confirmed: an empty draft turned the helper off): the override now applies only when the draft places at least one box (carriesBoxes in src/lib/layout-prompt.ts). On your GPU this is skipPromptHelper in the comfyui provider; on fal it is the payload's promptExpansion for routes with boundingBoxes. Other models' expansion still goes off for any layout. The 'on' label names the override: 'On · full caption (not with boxes)', shortened because the first wording was cut off in the browser at 390 and 1440 px. Tests cover an empty draft keeping the helper on both engines.

Finding 4 (low, confirmed: both endpoints are active and in fal's catalog): fal's plain blackforestlabs/flux-3/klein/base/text-to-image and base/edit-image were read with scripts/fetch-hosted-schemas.py --new10 <endpoint…>, which now takes endpoint ids and parses the '1K: $0.027' price form. They went into new-models-10.json endpointRecords and are now flux-3-klein-base's routes, with the /lora twins as loraEndpoint. Pricing is per image: $0.027 at 1K, $0.033 at 1.5K, $0.042 at 2K, $0.108 at 4K, plus withLorasPerMegapixel 0.035. The model is renamed 'FLUX 3 Klein Base'. The research note in new-models-10.md is corrected. The preview API on a fal-key server confirms 4K without LoRAs at $0.108 on the plain route, and 1K with a LoRA at $0.035 on /lora.

Finding 5 / main-session call (5): ModelDef.bestOps restricts the operations whose Best lists may rank a model by its badges. oss-flux3-klein has bestOps ['t2i'], so the Edit studio's open Best list is back to the base [Qwen-Image 2.1, Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo, FIBO 2 Dev, FIBO 2 Edit Turbo]. Klein is still offered in the Edit studio, and the Image Best list stays as built (Ideogram 4, Qwen-Image 2.1, FLUX 3 Klein, Krea 2 Realism). Tests in open-sota-studios and flux3-klein.

fix.finalSummary: FLUX 3 Image Klein on both engines, after the review fixes. OPEN ENGINE (your ComfyUI): oss-flux3-klein does text to image up to 4K and edits with up to 10 references; the edit follows reference 1 at about 1 MP. oss-flux3-klein-base runs Klein Base with your LoRAs. Three core-node graphs were validated earlier on the CPU ComfyUI. Options -> Prompt helper (BFL's w4a8 upsampler) is on by default; off sends your words as typed, and so does a layout once it places a box (an empty layout keeps the helper).
